title: Garlicky Portuguese Lamb Skewers
description: Tender lamb skewers infused with the flavors of garlic and the spices of Portugal. Perfect for a quick and easy summer meal.
instructions: Soak 4-6 wooden skewers in lightly salted water for at least 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, Portuguese seasoning, and olive oil.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto the skewers.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
